sections.title: Decades & This Year
sections.lead: You can use home and shared space as one observation theme for the current phase.
sections.text:
You can give deliberate attention to home and shared space when reviewing the current longer phase. The decadal cycle (dà xiàn — a traditional period of approximately ten years) points to the Property Palace (tián zhái gōng), which concerns how living arrangements, shared surroundings and a sense of settlement are maintained. The index marks a thematic entry point rather than a specific outcome. When rearranging a desk area or shared room, ask whether others most need quiet, storage or an easier route through the space. The quality of home life depends on boundaries and habits as well as objects; this symbol does not indicate ownership outcomes. Try to start with one frequently used area and agree on how it will be shared and maintained. Set a review date and assess whether the practice helped you allocate attention more clearly. The age boundaries arrange the traditional sequence; reaching one does not automatically change your circumstances.
You can give deliberate attention to working with your network when reviewing this year’s arrangements. The yearly layer (liú nián — a perspective calculated from the year’s parameters) points to the Friends Palace (jiāo yǒu gōng), which concerns exchanges among friends, team members and people you collaborate with. The index marks a thematic entry point rather than a specific outcome. If a group plans an event, distinguish those offering ideas, those owning tasks and those available only for occasional support. Friendship can coexist with a work agreement, but familiarity should not substitute for a clear handover or scope of authority. Try to write down the owner and completion point for one shared task. Set a review date and assess whether the practice helped you allocate attention more clearly. For a three year outlook, review actual milestones as new information arrives rather than extrapolating future events from this single yearly position.
You can reflect on ownership, responsibility and decision roles in mentoring and nurturing through this decadal layer. [[term:mutagen.quan]] (huà quán) — a transformation symbol for that emphasis — is linked to a star in the Children Palace (zǐ nǚ gōng), the area concerned with your approach to younger people, learners and projects that need patient development. The decadal layer uses the current phase parameters and offers a longer period for reviewing commitments. In practical terms, you may pay closer attention to who decides the next step and whether the responsible person has enough information and time.…

rawAnswer: I cannot give a specific promotion date. The chart only offers observational perspectives and cannot predict specific career events or guarantee outcomes.
